Third for third month was Banaias son of Iōdae the priest, chief, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:6**

This Banaias was mightier than thirty and over thirty, and over his division was Amizabad his son.

**1 Chronicles 27:7**

Fourth for fourth month was Asaēl brother of Ioab and Zabadias his son and brothers, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:8**

Fifth for fifth month, leader Samaōth the Iesrae, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:9**

Sixth for sixth month, Odouias son of Ekkēs the Thekoite, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:10**

Seventh for seventh month, Chellēs from Phallous, from sons of Ephraim, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:11**

Eighth for eighth month, Sobochai the Isathi for Zarai, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:12**

Ninth for ninth month, Abiezer from Anathōth, from land of Beniamin, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:13**

Tenth for tenth month, Mēēra from Netoupha for Zarai, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:14**

Eleventh for eleventh month, Banaias from Pharathōn, of sons of Ephraim, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:15**

Twelfth for twelfth month, Choldai the Netouphathi for Gothoniēl, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

**1 Chronicles 27:16**

And over tribes of Israel: for Reuben, leader Eliezer son of Zechri; for Symeon, Saphatias son of Maacha;

**1 Chronicles 27:17**

for Levi, Asabias son of Kamouēl; for Aaron, Sadok;

**1 Chronicles 27:18**

for Iouda, Eliab from brothers of Dauid; for Issachar, Ambri son of Michaēl;

**1 Chronicles 27:19**

for Zabulon, Samaias son of Abdiou; for Nephthali, Ierimōth son of Esriēl;

**1 Chronicles 27:20**

for Ephraim, Ōsē son of Oziou; for half tribe of Manasse, Ioēl son of Phadaia;

**1 Chronicles 27:21**

for half tribe of Manasse in Galaad, Iaddai son of Zabdiou; for sons of Beniamin, Asiēl son of Abennēr;

**1 Chronicles 27:22**

for Dan, Azaraiēl son of Iōram. These were patriarchs of tribes of Israel.

**1 Chronicles 27:23**

And Dauid did not take their number from twenty years and under, because Lord said to multiply Israel like stars of heaven.

**1 Chronicles 27:24**

And Ioab son of Sarouia began numbering among people and did not finish, and because of these things wrath came upon Israel, and number was not entered in book of matters of days of king Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 27:25**

And over king’s treasuries was Asmōth son of Ōdiēl, and over treasuries in field and in villages and in settlements and in towers was Ionathan son of Oziou.

**1 Chronicles 27:26**

And over those farming ground, those working soil, was Esdri son of Choloub.

**1 Chronicles 27:27**

And over vineyards was Semei from Rama, and over treasuries in vineyards of wine was Zachri son of Sephni.

**1 Chronicles 27:28**

And over olive groves and sycamines in lowland was Balanas the Gedōrite, and over treasuries of oil was Iōas.

**1 Chronicles 27:29**

And over cattle feeding in Asidōn was Satrais the Sarōnite, and over cattle in farmyards was Sōphat son of Adli.

**1 Chronicles 27:30**

And over camels was Ōbil the Ismaēlite, and over donkeys was Iadias from Merathōn.

**1 Chronicles 27:31**

And over sheep was Iaziz the Hagarite. All these were stewards of possessions of king Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 27:32**

And Ionathan, Dauid’s uncle, was counselor, understanding man and scribe, and Iiēl son of Achamani was with sons of king.

**1 Chronicles 27:33**

And Achitophel was counselor of king, and Chousi was first friend of king.

**1 Chronicles 27:34**

And after him: Achitophel, then Iōdae son of Banaiou and Abiathar, and Ioab commander-in-chief of king.

### Chapter 28

**1 Chronicles 28:1**

And Dauid assembled all rulers of Israel, rulers of judges and rulers of courses around body of king and rulers of thousands and of hundreds and treasurers and those over his possessions and mighty lords and fighters of army, in Ierousalem.

**1 Chronicles 28:2**

And Dauid stood in midst of assembly and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. It came upon my heart to build house of rest for ark of covenant of Lord and footstool of our Lord, and I prepared fitting things for dwelling.

**1 Chronicles 28:3**

But God said, You shall not build me house to have my name named upon it, because you are man of war and poured out blood.

**1 Chronicles 28:4**

And Lord God of Israel chose me from all house of my father to be king over Israel forever, and in Iouda he chose kingdom, and from house of Iouda house of my father, and among sons of my father he desired in me to make me king over all Israel.

**1 Chronicles 28:5**

And from all my sons, because Lord gave me many sons, he chose in Salomon my son to seat him upon throne of kingdom of Lord over Israel.

**1 Chronicles 28:6**

And God said to me, Salomon your son shall build my house and my court, because I chose him to be son to me, and I will be father to him.

**1 Chronicles 28:7**

And I will set his kingdom right forever, if he is strong to keep my commandments and my judgments, as this day.

**1 Chronicles 28:8**

And now, before all assembly of Lord and in ears of our God, keep and seek all commandments of Lord our God, so that you may inherit good land and leave inheritance to your sons after you forever.

**1 Chronicles 28:9**

And now, Salomon my son, know God of your fathers and serve him with complete heart and willing soul, because Lord examines all hearts and knows every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; and if you forsake him, he will forsake you to end.

**1 Chronicles 28:10**

See now, because Lord chose you to build him house for sanctuary. Be strong and do.

**1 Chronicles 28:11**

And Dauid gave to Salomon his son pattern of temple and of its houses and its treasuries and upper rooms and inner storehouses and house of propitiation,

**1 Chronicles 28:12**

and pattern which he had in his spirit of courts of house of Lord and all storerooms around, for treasuries of house of Lord and treasuries of holy things,

**1 Chronicles 28:13**

and of chambers of courses of priests and Levites, for every work of service of house of Lord and of storehouses of vessels of service of worship of house of Lord,

**1 Chronicles 28:14**

and weight of their weighing, both of gold and silver things,

**1 Chronicles 28:15**

weight of lampstands and of lamps he gave him,

**1 Chronicles 28:16**

he likewise gave him weight of tables of presentation, each golden table, and likewise silver ones,

**1 Chronicles 28:17**

and for flesh-hooks and bowls and golden cups, and weight of gold and of silver for each kefphoure according to weight,

**1 Chronicles 28:18**

and for altar of incense, weight from refined gold he showed him, and pattern of chariot of cheroubim spreading wings and overshadowing ark of covenant of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 28:19**

All in writing of hand of Lord, Dauid gave to Salomon according to understanding given to him for working of pattern.

**1 Chronicles 28:20**

And Dauid said to Salomon his son, Be strong and act like man and do. Do not fear and do not be dismayed, because Lord my God is with you. He will not let go of you and will not forsake you until you finish every work of service of house of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 28:21**

And behold, courses of priests and Levites for every service of house of God are with you, and with you in every work are all willing men in wisdom for every craft, and rulers and all people for all your words.

### Chapter 29

**1 Chronicles 29:1**

And king Dauid said to all assembly, Salomon my son, in whom alone Lord chose, is young and tender, and work is great, because building not for man but for Lord God.

**1 Chronicles 29:2**

With all my strength I prepared for house of my God gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, shoham stones and filling stones and precious stones and varied stones and every precious stone and much Parian stone.

**1 Chronicles 29:3**

And still, because I delighted in house of my God, I have gold and silver which I kept for myself, and behold, I gave it for house of my God in addition to what I prepared for house of holy things,

**1 Chronicles 29:4**

three thousand talents of gold from Souphir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay walls of sanctuary with them,

**1 Chronicles 29:5**

by hand of craftsmen. And who is willing to fill his hands for Lord today?

**1 Chronicles 29:6**

And chiefs of fathers and rulers of sons of Israel and commanders of thousands and of hundreds and leaders of works and stewards of king were made willing.

**1 Chronicles 29:7**

And they gave for works of house of Lord five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold pieces, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

**1 Chronicles 29:8**

And those with whom stone was found gave it to treasuries of house of Lord by hand of Iiēl the Gērsōnite.

**1 Chronicles 29:9**

And people rejoiced over their willingness, because with full heart they were made willing to Lord, and king Dauid rejoiced greatly.

**1 Chronicles 29:10**

And king Dauid blessed Lord before assembly, saying, Blessed are you, Lord God of Israel our father, from age and unto age.

**1 Chronicles 29:11**

Yours, Lord, are greatness and power and boasting and victory and strength, because you rule all things in heaven and on earth; before your face every king and nation is troubled.

**1 Chronicles 29:12**

From you are riches and glory; you rule all things, Lord, ruler of every beginning, and in your hand are strength and lordship, and in your hand, Almighty One, to magnify and strengthen all things.

**1 Chronicles 29:13**

And now, Lord, we give thanks to you and praise name of your boasting.

**1 Chronicles 29:14**

And who am I, and who are my people, that we grew strong to be willing to you in this way? Because all things are yours, and from your things we gave to you.

**1 Chronicles 29:15**

Because we are sojourners before you and temporary residents, as all our fathers were. Our days on earth are like shadow, and there is no staying.

**1 Chronicles 29:16**

Lord our God, all this abundance which I prepared to build house for your holy name is from your hand, and all things are yours.

**1 Chronicles 29:17**

And I knew, Lord, that you examine hearts and love righteousness. In simplicity of heart I was willing for all these things, and now I saw your people found here willingly giving to you with gladness.

**1 Chronicles 29:18**

Lord God of Abraam and Isaak and Israel our fathers, keep these things in thought of heart of your people forever, and direct their hearts toward you.

**1 Chronicles 29:19**

And to Salomon my son give good heart to do your commandments and your testimonies and your ordinances, and to bring building of your house to completion.

**1 Chronicles 29:20**

And Dauid said to all assembly, Bless Lord your God. And all assembly blessed Lord God of their fathers, and bowing knees they worshiped Lord and king.

**1 Chronicles 29:21**

And Dauid sacrificed sacrifices to Lord and offered whole burnt offerings to God on next day after first day: one thousand calves, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, and their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

**1 Chronicles 29:22**

And they ate and drank before Lord on that day with joy, and they made Salomon son of Dauid king a second time, and anointed him to Lord as king and Sadok to priesthood.

**1 Chronicles 29:23**

And Salomon sat on throne of Dauid his father and prospered, and all Israel listened to him.

**1 Chronicles 29:24**

Rulers and mighty lords and all sons of king Dauid his father submitted to him.

**1 Chronicles 29:25**

And Lord magnified Salomon exceedingly before all Israel and gave him royal glory such as did not happen on any king before him.

**1 Chronicles 29:26**

And Dauid son of Iessai reigned over Israel.

**1 Chronicles 29:27**

Forty years: in Chebron seven years and in Ierousalem thirty-three years.

**1 Chronicles 29:28**

And he died in good old age, full of days, riches, and glory, and Salomon his son reigned in his place.

**1 Chronicles 29:29**

And rest of matters of king Dauid, first and last, are written in words of Samuel seer and in words of Nathan prophet and in words of Gad seer,

**1 Chronicles 29:30**

concerning all his kingdom and his mighty rule and times which came upon him and upon Israel and upon all kingdoms of earth.

## 2 Chronicles

### Chapter 1

**2 Chronicles 1:1**

And Salomon son of Dauid was strengthened over his kingdom, and Lord his God was with him and magnified him on high.

**2 Chronicles 1:2**

And Salomon spoke to all Israel, to commanders of thousands and of hundreds and to judges and to all rulers before Israel, to chiefs of fathers.

**2 Chronicles 1:3**

And Salomon and all assembly with him went to high place in Gabaon, because there was tent of testimony of God which Moyses servant of Lord made in wilderness.

**2 Chronicles 1:4**

But Dauid brought up ark of God from city Kariathiarim, because he prepared tent for it in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 1:5**

And bronze altar which Beseleēl son of Ourios son of Ōr made was there before tent of Lord, and Salomon and assembly sought it.

**2 Chronicles 1:6**

And there Salomon brought up upon bronze altar before Lord, the one in tent, and brought up upon it one thousand whole burnt offerings.

**2 Chronicles 1:7**

In that night God appeared to Salomon and said to him, Ask what I should give you.

**2 Chronicles 1:8**

And Salomon said to God, You did great mercy with Dauid my father and made me king in his place.

**2 Chronicles 1:9**

And now, Lord God, let your name be made faithful upon Dauid my father, because you made me king over numerous people like dust of earth.

**2 Chronicles 1:10**

Now give me wisdom and understanding, and I shall go out before this people and come in, because who can judge this great people of yours?

**2 Chronicles 1:11**

And God said to Salomon, Because this came to be in your heart, and you did not ask wealth, riches, or glory, nor life of your adversaries, nor many days, but asked wisdom and understanding for yourself so that you may judge my people over whom I made you king,

**2 Chronicles 1:12**

wisdom and understanding I give to you, and wealth and riches and glory I will give to you such as none among kings before you had, and after you there shall not be thus.

**2 Chronicles 1:13**

And Salomon came from high place in Gabaon to Ierousalem, from before tent of testimony, and reigned over Israel.

**2 Chronicles 1:14**

And Salomon gathered chariots and horsemen, and he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he placed them in cities of chariots, and people were with king in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 1:15**

And king made gold and silver in Ierousalem like stones, and cedars in Iouda like sycamines in lowland in abundance.

**2 Chronicles 1:16**

And export of horses for Salomon was from Egypt, and merchants of king were trading and buying at price.

**2 Chronicles 1:17**

And they were bringing up and bringing out from Egypt chariot for six hundred silver and horse for one hundred fifty, and thus for all kings of Chettites and kings of Syria they brought by their hands.

**2 Chronicles 1:18**

And Salomon spoke of building house to name of Lord and house for his kingdom.

### Chapter 2

**2 Chronicles 2:1**

And Salomon gathered seventy thousand men and eighty thousand stonecutters in mountain and three thousand six hundred overseers over them.

**2 Chronicles 2:2**

And Salomon sent to Chiram king of Tyre, saying, As you did with Dauid my father and sent him cedars to build house for himself to dwell in it,

**2 Chronicles 2:3**

behold, I his son am building house to name of Lord my God, to sanctify it to him, to burn incense of spices before him and perpetual presentation and to offer whole burnt offerings continually morning and evening and on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts of Lord our God. This is forever upon Israel.

**2 Chronicles 2:4**

And house which I am building is great, because our God is great above all gods.

**2 Chronicles 2:5**

And who will have strength to build him house? Because heaven and heaven of heavens do not bear his glory. And who am I building him house, except to burn incense before him?

**2 Chronicles 2:6**

And now send me wise man, one knowing how to work in gold and silver and bronze and iron and purple and scarlet and blue, and knowing how to carve carving, together with wise men with me in Iouda and in Ierousalem, whom Dauid my father prepared.

**2 Chronicles 2:7**

And send me cedar woods and juniper woods and pine woods from Lebanon, because I know your servants know how to cut woods from Lebanon, and behold, your servants are with my servants,

**2 Chronicles 2:8**

to prepare woods for me in abundance, because house which I am building is great and glorious.

**2 Chronicles 2:9**

And behold, for workers, those cutting woods for food, I gave grain to your servants, twenty thousand kors, and barley, twenty thousand kors, and wine, twenty thousand measures, and oil, twenty thousand measures.

**2 Chronicles 2:10**

And Chiram king of Tyre answered in writing and sent to Salomon, Because Lord loved his people, he gave you king over them.

**2 Chronicles 2:11**

And Chiram said, Blessed Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth, who gave to king Dauid wise son, knowing understanding and knowledge, who will build house to Lord and house for his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 2:12**

And now I have sent to you wise man, knowing understanding, Chiram my father,

**2 Chronicles 2:13**

whose mother was from daughters of Dan and whose father was Tyrian man, knowing how to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron, in stones and woods, and to weave in purple and in blue and in fine linen and in scarlet, and to carve carvings and devise every design whatever you give him, together with your wise men and wise men of Dauid my lord your father.

**2 Chronicles 2:14**

And now let my lord send to his servants grain and barley and oil and wine which my lord spoke of.

**2 Chronicles 2:15**

And we shall cut woods from Lebanon according to all your need, and we shall bring them on rafts by sea to Ioppē, and you shall bring them up to Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 2:16**

And Salomon gathered all sojourning men in land of Israel, after number by which Dauid his father numbered them, and they were found to be one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

**2 Chronicles 2:17**

And he made from them seventy thousand carriers of burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters and three thousand six hundred overseers over people.

### Chapter 3

**2 Chronicles 3:1**

And Salomon began building house of Lord in Ierousalem on mountain of Amoria, where Lord appeared to Dauid his father, in place which Dauid prepared at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.

**2 Chronicles 3:2**

And he began building in second month, in fourth year of his reign.

**2 Chronicles 3:3**

And these are foundations which Salomon laid for building house of God: length by first measure, sixty cubits, and width twenty cubits.

**2 Chronicles 3:4**

And vestibule before house, length according to breadth of house, twenty cubits, and height one hundred twenty cubits, and he overlaid it inside with pure gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:5**

And great house he paneled with cedar woods and overlaid it with pure gold and carved upon it palms and chains.

**2 Chronicles 3:6**

And he adorned house with precious stones for glory, and with gold, gold from Pharouaim.

**2 Chronicles 3:7**

And he gilded house and walls and doorposts and ceilings and doors with gold, and carved cheroubim on walls.

**2 Chronicles 3:8**

And he made house of holy of holies, its length according to breadth, twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits, and he overlaid it with pure gold, for cheroubim, six hundred talents.

**2 Chronicles 3:9**

And weight of nails, weight of one, fifty shekels of gold, and upper rooms he gilded with gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:10**

And he made in house of holy of holies two cheroubim, work from woods, and gilded them with gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:11**

And wings of cheroubim were twenty cubits in length; one wing five cubits touching wall of house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.

**2 Chronicles 3:12**

And wing of one cheroub was five cubits touching wall of house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.

**2 Chronicles 3:13**

And wings of cheroubim spread out were twenty cubits, and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward house.

**2 Chronicles 3:14**

And he made veil of blue and purple and scarlet and fine linen, and wove cheroubim in it.

**2 Chronicles 3:15**

And he made before house two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, and their capitals five cubits.

**2 Chronicles 3:16**

And he made chains in debir and put them on heads of pillars, and he made one hundred pomegranates and put them on chains.

**2 Chronicles 3:17**

And he set pillars before temple, one at right and one at left, and he called name of right one Uprightness and name of left one Strength.

### Chapter 4

**2 Chronicles 4:1**

And he made bronze altar, twenty cubits long and twenty cubits broad and ten cubits high.

**2 Chronicles 4:2**

And he made cast sea, ten cubits across, round all around, and its height five cubits, and its circuit thirty cubits.

**2 Chronicles 4:3**

And likeness of calves under it around encircled it, ten cubits surrounding laver all around, two kinds having cast calves in their casting.

**2 Chronicles 4:4**

Which they made: twelve calves, three facing north and three facing west and three facing south and three facing east, and sea was above them, and their hind parts were inward.

**2 Chronicles 4:5**

And its thickness was a handbreadth, and its rim like rim of cup, carved lily blossoms, holding three thousand measures, and it was finished.

**2 Chronicles 4:6**

And he made ten lavers and set five on right and five on left, to wash in them works of whole burnt offerings and rinse in them, and sea was for priests to wash in it.

**2 Chronicles 4:7**

And he made ten gold lampstands according to their ordinance and set them in temple, five on right and five on left.

**2 Chronicles 4:8**

And he made ten tables and set them in temple, five on right and five on left, and he made one hundred golden bowls.

**2 Chronicles 4:9**

And he made court of priests and great court and doors for court, and their door-panels plated with bronze.

**2 Chronicles 4:10**

And he set sea from corner of house on right, toward east, opposite.

**2 Chronicles 4:11**

And Chiram made flesh-hooks and firepans and grate of altar and all its vessels, and Chiram finished making all work which Salomon the king made in house of God:

**2 Chronicles 4:12**

two pillars, and upon them bowl-capitals on heads of pillars, two, and two nets to cover two bowl-capitals which were on heads of pillars,

**2 Chronicles 4:13**

and four hundred golden pomegranates for two nets, two sets of pomegranates on one net to cover two bowl-capitals which were above pillars,

**2 Chronicles 4:14**

and he made ten stands and made lavers upon stands,

**2 Chronicles 4:15**

and one sea and twelve calves under it,

**2 Chronicles 4:16**

and footstools and forks and cauldrons and flesh-hooks and all their vessels, which Chiram made and brought to king Salomon for house of Lord, of pure bronze.

**2 Chronicles 4:17**

In region of Jordan king cast them in thickness of earth, in house of Sokchōth and between Sirdatha.

**2 Chronicles 4:18**

And Salomon made all these vessels in very great abundance, because weight of bronze did not fail.

**2 Chronicles 4:19**

And Salomon made all vessels of house of Lord, and golden altar and tables, and on them breads of presentation,

**2 Chronicles 4:20**

and lampstands and lamps for light according to ordinance and before debir, of pure gold,

**2 Chronicles 4:21**

and their tongs and their lamps and bowls and censers and firepans of pure gold,

**2 Chronicles 4:22**

and inner door of house into holy of holies, and doors of house of temple, golden.

### Chapter 5

**2 Chronicles 5:1**

And all work which Salomon made in house of Lord was finished, and Salomon brought in holy things of Dauid his father, silver and gold and vessels, and gave them into treasure of house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 5:2**

Then Salomon assembled elders of Israel and all rulers of tribes, leaders of fathers of sons of Israel, in Ierousalem, to bring up ark of covenant of Lord from City of Dauid, this is Sion.

**2 Chronicles 5:3**

And every man of Israel was assembled to king at feast, this seventh month.

**2 Chronicles 5:4**

And all elders of Israel came, and all Levites took ark.

**2 Chronicles 5:5**

And they brought up ark and tent of testimony and all holy vessels in tent; priests and Levites brought them up.

**2 Chronicles 5:6**

And king Salomon and all congregation of Israel, those fearing and gathered with him before ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep which cannot be numbered and cannot be reckoned from multitude.

**2 Chronicles 5:7**

And priests brought in ark of covenant of Lord to its place, into debir of house, into holy of holies, under wings of cheroubim.

**2 Chronicles 5:8**

And cheroubim were spreading out their wings over place of ark, and cheroubim were covering ark and its carrying-poles above.

**2 Chronicles 5:9**

And carrying-poles projected, and heads of poles were seen from holy place before debir, but were not seen outside, and they were there until this day.

**2 Chronicles 5:10**

There was nothing in ark except two tablets which Moyses put in Chōrēb, when Lord made covenant with sons of Israel as they came out from land of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 5:11**

And it came to pass when priests came out from holy place, because all priests found there had sanctified themselves; they were not arranged by courses.

**2 Chronicles 5:12**

And Levites, singers, all sons of Asaph, Haiman, Idithoun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed in linen robes with cymbals and harps and lyres, were standing opposite altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests blowing trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 5:13**

And one sound came to be in blowing trumpets and in singing psalms and in sounding one voice, to give thanks and praise to Lord. And as they raised voice with trumpets and cymbals and instruments of songs and said, Give thanks to Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever, house was filled with cloud of glory of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 5:14**

And priests were not able to stand to minister from presence of cloud, because glory of Lord filled house of God.

### Chapter 6

**2 Chronicles 6:1**

Then Salomon said, Lord said he would dwell in thick darkness.

**2 Chronicles 6:2**

And I built holy house to your name for you, ready for dwelling forever.

**2 Chronicles 6:3**

And king turned his face and blessed all assembly of Israel, and all assembly of Israel stood there.

**2 Chronicles 6:4**

And he said, Blessed Lord God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to Dauid my father and with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

**2 Chronicles 6:5**

From day when I brought my people out of land of Egypt, I did not choose city from all tribes of Israel to build house for my name to be there, and I did not choose man to be ruler over my people Israel,

**2 Chronicles 6:6**

but I chose Ierousalem for my name to be there, and I chose Dauid to be over my people Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:7**

And it came upon heart of Dauid my father to build house to name of Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:8**

And Lord said to Dauid my father, Because it came upon your heart to build house to my name, you did well that it came upon your heart.

**2 Chronicles 6:9**

Nevertheless, you shall not build house, but your son who shall come out from your loins, he shall build house to my name.

**2 Chronicles 6:10**

And Lord raised up his word which he spoke, and I came to be in place of Dauid my father and sat upon throne of Israel, as Lord spoke, and I built house to name of Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:11**

And there I put ark, in which is covenant of Lord which he made with Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:12**

And he stood before altar of Lord in presence of all assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

**2 Chronicles 6:13**

For Salomon made bronze platform and set it in midst of court of sanctuary, its length five cubits and breadth five cubits and height three cubits, and he stood upon it and fell on his knees before all assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

**2 Chronicles 6:14**

And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven and on earth, keeping covenant and mercy for your servants walking before you with whole heart,

**2 Chronicles 6:15**

what you kept for your servant Dauid my father, what you spoke to him saying, and you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, as this day.

**2 Chronicles 6:16**

And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for your servant Dauid my father what you spoke to him, saying, Man shall not fail for you from before me sitting on throne of Israel, if only your sons keep their way to walk in my law as you walked before me.

**2 Chronicles 6:17**

And now, Lord God of Israel, let your word be made faithful, which you spoke to your servant Dauid.

**2 Chronicles 6:18**

For will God truly dwell with men upon earth? If heaven and heaven of heaven are not sufficient for you, then what is this house which I built?

**2 Chronicles 6:19**

And you shall look upon prayer of your servant and upon my petition, Lord God, to hear petition and prayer which your servant prays before you today,

**2 Chronicles 6:20**

that your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon this place where you said your name would be called there, to hear prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

**2 Chronicles 6:21**

And you shall hear petition of your servant and your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place, and you shall hear from place of your dwelling, from heaven, and you shall hear and be merciful.

**2 Chronicles 6:22**

If man sins against his neighbor and takes oath upon him to swear him, and comes and swears before altar in this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:23**

then you shall hear from heaven and do and judge your servants, repaying lawless one, to return his ways upon his head, and justifying righteous one, to give to him according to his righteousness.

**2 Chronicles 6:24**

And if your people Israel are crushed before enemy when they sin against you, and they turn and give thanks to your name and pray and entreat before you in this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:25**

then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to sins of your people Israel and return them to land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 6:26**

When heaven is shut and rain does not come because they sin against you, and they pray toward this place and praise your name and turn from their sins because you humbled them,

**2 Chronicles 6:27**

then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to sins of your servants and your people Israel, because you will show them good way in which they shall walk, and you will give rain upon your land which you gave to your people for inheritance.

**2 Chronicles 6:28**

If famine comes on land, if death comes, if blight and jaundice come, locust and caterpillar, if enemy afflicts them before their cities, according to every plague and every pain,

**2 Chronicles 6:29**

then every prayer and every petition which happens to every man and to all your people Israel, if a man knows his own touch and his own weakness and spreads out his hands toward this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:30**

then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and be gracious and give to each man according to his ways, as you know his heart, because you alone know heart of sons of men,

**2 Chronicles 6:31**

so that they may fear your ways all days which they live upon face of land which you gave to our fathers.

**2 Chronicles 6:32**

And every foreigner who is not from your people Israel, and comes from far land because of your great name and your strong hand and your uplifted arm, and comes and prays toward this place,

**2 Chronicles 6:33**

then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and do according to all things whatever foreigner calls upon you for, so that all peoples of earth may know your name and fear you as your people Israel and know that your name is called upon this house which I built.

**2 Chronicles 6:34**

If your people go out to battle against their enemies on way where you send them, and they pray to you by way of this city which you chose and house which I built to your name,

**2 Chronicles 6:35**

then hear from heaven their petition and their prayer and do their justice.

**2 Chronicles 6:36**

Because they will sin against you, for there will not be man who will not sin, and you will strike them and hand them over before enemies, and those taking them captive shall take them captive to land of enemies, far or near,

**2 Chronicles 6:37**

and they will turn heart in their land where they were taken, and indeed turn and entreat you in their captivity, saying, We sinned, we acted unjustly, we acted lawlessly,

**2 Chronicles 6:38**

and turn toward you with all heart and all soul in land of those who took them captive, and pray by way of their land which you gave to their fathers and city which you chose and house which I built to your name,

**2 Chronicles 6:39**

then hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, their prayer and their petition and do judgments and be merciful to your people who sinned against you.

**2 Chronicles 6:40**

Now, Lord, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to petition of this place.

**2 Chronicles 6:41**

And now rise up, Lord God, into your resting place, you and ark of your strength. Let your priests, Lord God, put on salvation, and let your sons rejoice in good things.

**2 Chronicles 6:42**

Lord God, do not turn away face of your anointed one; remember mercies of Dauid your servant.

### Chapter 7

**2 Chronicles 7:1**

And when Salomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, and glory of Lord filled house.

**2 Chronicles 7:2**

And priests were not able to enter house of Lord at that time, because glory of Lord filled house.

**2 Chronicles 7:3**

And all sons of Israel saw fire coming down and glory of Lord upon house, and they fell upon face to ground on pavement and worshiped and praised Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.

**2 Chronicles 7:4**

And king and all people were sacrificing sacrifices before Lord.

**2 Chronicles 7:5**

And Salomon sacrificed sacrifice of twenty-two thousand calves and one hundred twenty thousand cattle, and king and all people dedicated house of God.

**2 Chronicles 7:6**

And priests stood at their charges, and Levites with instruments of songs of Lord, of Dauid king, for giving thanks before Lord, because his mercy is forever, with hymns of Dauid by their hand, and priests were blowing trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

**2 Chronicles 7:7**

And Salomon sanctified middle of court in house of Lord, because there he made whole burnt offerings and fat of peace offerings, because bronze altar which Salomon made was not able to receive whole burnt offerings and grain offerings and fats.

**2 Chronicles 7:8**

And Salomon made feast at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, very great assembly, from entrance of Hamath and as far as river of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 7:9**

And on eighth day he made dismissal, because dedication of altar he made seven days, feast.

**2 Chronicles 7:10**

And on twenty-third of seventh month he sent people to their tents rejoicing and with good heart over good things which Lord did to Dauid and to Salomon and to Israel his people.

**2 Chronicles 7:11**

And Salomon finished house of Lord and house of king, and all things which Salomon desired in his soul to do in house of Lord and in his house prospered.

**2 Chronicles 7:12**

And God appeared to Salomon by night and said to him, I heard your prayer and chose in this place for myself as house of sacrifice.

**2 Chronicles 7:13**

If I shut heaven and rain does not come, and if I command locust to eat tree, and if I send death among my people,

**2 Chronicles 7:14**

and my people upon whom my name has been called are put to shame, and they pray and seek my face and turn from their evil ways, then I will hear from heaven and be merciful to their sins and heal their land.

**2 Chronicles 7:15**

Now my eyes shall be open and my ears attentive to prayer of this place.

**2 Chronicles 7:16**

And now I have chosen and sanctified this house for my name to be there forever, and my eyes and my heart shall be there all days.

**2 Chronicles 7:17**

And you, if you walk before me as Dauid your father and do according to all things I commanded you and keep my ordinances and my judgments,

**2 Chronicles 7:18**

then I will set up throne of your kingdom as I covenanted with Dauid your father, saying, Man leading in Israel shall not be removed from you.

**2 Chronicles 7:19**

And if you turn away and forsake my ordinances and my commandments which I gave before you and go and serve other gods and worship them,

**2 Chronicles 7:20**

then I will lift you out of land which I gave them, and this house which I sanctified to my name I will cast away from my face and give it for parable and tale among all nations.

**2 Chronicles 7:21**

And this exalted house, everyone passing by it will be astonished and say, For what reason did Lord do thus to this land and to this house?

**2 Chronicles 7:22**

And they shall say, Because they forsook Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out from land of Egypt, and laid hold of other gods and worshiped them and served them, therefore he brought upon them all this evil.

### Chapter 8

**2 Chronicles 8:1**

And it came to pass after twenty years in which Salomon built house of Lord and his own house,

**2 Chronicles 8:2**

and cities which Chiram gave to Salomon, Salomon built them and settled sons of Israel there.

**2 Chronicles 8:3**

And Salomon came to Aimath Sōba and prevailed over it.

**2 Chronicles 8:4**

And he built Thedmor in wilderness and all strong cities which he built in Hamath.

**2 Chronicles 8:5**

And he built Baithōrōn the upper and Baithōrōn the lower, fortified cities, walls, gates, and bars,

**2 Chronicles 8:6**

and Baalath and all strong cities which belonged to Salomon and all cities of chariots and cities of horsemen and whatever Salomon desired according to desire to build in Ierousalem and in Lebanon and in all his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 8:7**

All people left over from Chettite and Amorite and Pherezite and Heuite and Iebousite, who were not from Israel,

**2 Chronicles 8:8**

**2 Chronicles 8:9**

But from sons of Israel Salomon did not make servants for his kingdom, because they were men of war and rulers and mighty men and rulers of chariots and horsemen.

**2 Chronicles 8:10**

**2 Chronicles 8:11**

**2 Chronicles 8:12**

Then Salomon brought up whole burnt offerings to Lord on altar which he built opposite temple.

**2 Chronicles 8:13**

And according to matter of each day, for offering according to commandments of Moyses, on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts three times of year, in feast of unleavened bread and in feast of weeks and in feast of tents.

**2 Chronicles 8:14**

And he established according to ordinance of Dauid divisions of priests according to their services, and Levites in their charges to praise and minister before priests according to matter of day in its day, and gatekeepers in their divisions for gate and gate, because thus were commandments of Dauid man of God.

**2 Chronicles 8:15**

They did not pass by commands of king concerning priests and Levites in every matter and concerning treasuries.

**2 Chronicles 8:16**

**2 Chronicles 8:17**

Then Salomon went to Gasiōngaber and to Ailath by sea in land of Idoumaia.

**2 Chronicles 8:18**

### Chapter 9

**2 Chronicles 9:1**

And queen of Saba heard name of Salomon and came to test Salomon with riddles in Ierousalem, with very weighty force, and camels carrying spices and gold in abundance and precious stone, and she came to Salomon and spoke with him all things in her soul.

**2 Chronicles 9:2**

And Salomon declared to her all her matters, and no matter passed from Salomon which he did not declare to her.

**2 Chronicles 9:3**

And queen of Saba saw wisdom of Salomon and house which he built,

**2 Chronicles 9:4**

and foods of his tables and seating of his servants and standing of his ministers and their clothing and his cupbearers and their apparel and whole burnt offerings which he offered in house of Lord, and she was beside herself.

**2 Chronicles 9:5**

And she said to king, True was word which I heard in my land concerning your matters and concerning your wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:6**

And I did not believe words until I came and my eyes saw, and behold, half multitude of your wisdom was not reported to me. You added beyond report which I heard.

**2 Chronicles 9:7**

Blessed your men; blessed these servants of yours standing before you continually and hearing your wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:8**

Let Lord your God be blessed, who desired you to give you upon his throne as king for Lord your God. Because Lord your God loved Israel to establish him forever, he gave you over them as king to do judgment and righteousness.

**2 Chronicles 9:9**

And she gave to king one hundred twenty talents of gold and spices in very great abundance and precious stone, and there were no spices like those which queen of Saba gave to king Salomon.

**2 Chronicles 9:10**

And servants of Salomon and servants of Chiram were bringing gold to Salomon from Souphir and pine woods and precious stone.

**2 Chronicles 9:11**

And king made from pine woods stairways for house of Lord and for house of king and lyres and harps for singers, and such things were not seen before in land of Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 9:12**

And king Salomon gave to queen of Saba all her desires which she asked, besides all which she brought to king Salomon, and she returned to her land.

**2 Chronicles 9:13**

And weight of gold brought to Salomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

**2 Chronicles 9:14**

**2 Chronicles 9:15**

And king Salomon made two hundred beaten-gold shields; six hundred pure golds went upon one shield.

**2 Chronicles 9:16**

And three hundred beaten-gold bucklers; three hundred golds went up on each buckler, and king put them in house of forest of Lebanon.

**2 Chronicles 9:17**

And king made great ivory throne and overlaid it with refined gold.

**2 Chronicles 9:18**

And six steps to throne, fastened with gold, and armrests on this side and on that side on seat of throne, and two lions standing beside armrests.

**2 Chronicles 9:19**

And twelve lions standing there on six steps, on this side and that side. Thus it had not been done in any kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:20**

And all vessels of king Salomon were of gold, and all vessels of house of forest of Lebanon covered with gold; silver was not reckoned in days of Salomon as anything.

**2 Chronicles 9:21**

Because ships went for king to Tharsis with servants of Chiram; once every three years ships came from Tharsis to king full of gold and silver and ivory and monkeys.

**2 Chronicles 9:22**

And Salomon was magnified above all kings in wealth and wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:23**

And all kings of earth were seeking face of Salomon to hear his wisdom which God gave in his heart.

**2 Chronicles 9:24**

And they were bringing each his gifts, silver vessels and gold vessels and clothing, myrrh and spices, horses and mules, year by year.

**2 Chronicles 9:25**

And Salomon had four thousand mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he put them in cities of chariots and with king in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 9:26**

And he was ruling all kings from river and as far as land of Philistines and as far as border of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 9:27**

And king made gold and silver in Ierousalem like stones, and cedars like sycamines in lowland in abundance.

**2 Chronicles 9:28**

And export of horses from Egypt was for Salomon, and from all land.

**2 Chronicles 9:29**

And rest of matters of Salomon, first and last, behold, written in words of Nathan prophet and in words of Achia the Sēlōnite and in visions of Iōēl the seer concerning Ieroboam son of Nabat.

**2 Chronicles 9:30**

And king Salomon reigned over all Israel forty years.

**2 Chronicles 9:31**

And Salomon slept, and they buried him in city of Dauid his father, and Roboam his son reigned in his place.

### Chapter 10

**2 Chronicles 10:1**

And Roboam came to Sychem, because all Israel came to Sychem to make him king.

**2 Chronicles 10:2**

And it came to pass when Ieroboam son of Nabat heard, while he himself was in Egypt, since he fled from before king Salomon, and Ieroboam dwelt in Egypt, and Ieroboam returned from Egypt,

**2 Chronicles 10:3**

and they sent and called him, and Ieroboam and all assembly of Israel came to Roboam, saying,

**2 Chronicles 10:4**

Your father made our yoke hard, and now lighten from hard service of your father and from his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve you.

**2 Chronicles 10:5**

And he said to them, Go for three days and come again to me. And people departed.

**2 Chronicles 10:6**

And king Roboam gathered elders who stood before Salomon his father while he lived, saying, How do you counsel to answer word to this people?

**2 Chronicles 10:7**

And they spoke to him, saying, If today you become for good to this people and are pleased and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants all days.

**2 Chronicles 10:8**

But he left counsel of elders who counseled him and took counsel with young men brought up with him, who stood before him.

**2 Chronicles 10:9**

And he said to them, What do you counsel, and what word shall I answer this people who spoke to me saying, Lighten from yoke which your father put upon us?

**2 Chronicles 10:10**

And young men brought up with him spoke to him thus: Thus you shall speak to people who spoke to you saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, and you, lighten from us. Thus you shall say: My little finger is thicker than loins of my father.

**2 Chronicles 10:11**

And now, my father disciplined you with heavy yoke, and I will add upon your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.

**2 Chronicles 10:12**

And Ieroboam and all people came to Roboam on third day, as king spoke saying, Return to me on third day.

**2 Chronicles 10:13**

And king answered harshly, and king Roboam left counsel of elders.

**2 Chronicles 10:14**

And he spoke to them according to counsel of younger men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add upon it. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.

**2 Chronicles 10:15**

And king did not listen to people, because turn came from God, so that Lord might raise up his word which he spoke by hand of Achia the Sēlōnite concerning Ieroboam son of Nabat.

**2 Chronicles 10:16**

And all Israel saw that king did not listen to them, and people answered king saying, What share do we have in Dauid and inheritance in son of Iessai? To your tents, Israel. Now see your house, Dauid. And all Israel went to his tents.

**2 Chronicles 10:17**

But over men of Israel dwelling in cities of Iouda, Roboam reigned over them.

**2 Chronicles 10:18**

And king Roboam sent Adōniram over tribute, and sons of Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. And king Roboam hurried to go up into chariot to flee to Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 10:19**

And Israel broke covenant with house of Dauid until this day.

### Chapter 11

**2 Chronicles 11:1**

Speak to Roboam son of Salomon and to all Iouda and Beniamin, saying,

and Baithsoura and Sokchōth and Odollam,

and Geth and Marisan and Ziph,

### Chapter 12

**2 Chronicles 12:1**

And it came to pass, when kingdom of Roboam was prepared and as he grew strong, he forsook commandments of Lord, and all Israel with him.

**2 Chronicles 12:7**

**2 Chronicles 12:8**

For they shall be servants, and they shall know my service and service of kingdom of earth.

**2 Chronicles 12:9**

**2 Chronicles 12:10**

**2 Chronicles 12:11**

**2 Chronicles 12:12**
