**2 Chronicles 12:13**

And Roboam was strengthened in Ierousalem and reigned. Roboam was forty-one years old when he reigned, and he reigned seventeen years in Ierousalem, in city which Lord chose to name his name there from all tribes of sons of Israel, and name of his mother was Noomma the Ammonite.

**2 Chronicles 12:14**

And he did evil, because he did not direct his heart to seek Lord.

**2 Chronicles 12:15**

And matters of Roboam, first and last, behold, are they not written in words of Samaias the prophet and Addō the seer and his acts? And Roboam fought Ieroboam all his days.

**2 Chronicles 12:16**

And Roboam died and was buried with his fathers and was buried in City of Dauid, and Abia his son reigned in his place.

### Chapter 13

**2 Chronicles 13:1**

In eighteenth year of reign of Ieroboam, Abia reigned over Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 13:2**

He reigned three years in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Maacha daughter of Ouriēl from Gabaon. And there was war between Abia and Ieroboam.

**2 Chronicles 13:3**

And Abia drew up battle with force of mighty warriors, four hundred thousand mighty men, and Ieroboam drew up battle against him with eight hundred thousand mighty warriors.

**2 Chronicles 13:4**

And Abia stood up from mount Somorōn, which is in mountain of Ephraim, and said, Hear, Ieroboam and all Israel.

**2 Chronicles 13:5**

Is it not for you to know that Lord God of Israel gave kingdom over Israel forever to Dauid and to his sons, covenant of salt?

**2 Chronicles 13:6**

And Ieroboam son of Nabat, servant of Salomon son of Dauid, rose up and rebelled from his lord.

**2 Chronicles 13:7**

And pestilent men, lawless sons, gathered to him and stood against Roboam son of Salomon, and Roboam was younger and timid in heart and did not stand against him.

**2 Chronicles 13:8**

And now you say you will stand against kingdom of Lord by hand of sons of Dauid, and you are many people, and with you are golden calves which Ieroboam made for you as gods.

**2 Chronicles 13:9**

Did you not cast out priests of Lord, sons of Aaron, and Levites, and make for yourselves priests from people of land? Everyone coming to fill hands with young bull from cattle and seven rams became priest to what was not god.

**2 Chronicles 13:10**

But we have not forsaken Lord our God, and his priests minister to Lord, sons of Aaron, and Levites in their courses.

**2 Chronicles 13:11**

They burn to Lord whole burnt offerings morning and evening and incense of compounded spices and presentations of bread upon pure table, and golden lampstand and its lamps for burning to light at evening, because we keep charges of Lord God of our fathers, but you forsake him.

**2 Chronicles 13:12**

And behold, with us at beginning is Lord, and his priests and trumpets of signal to sound against you. Sons of Israel, do not fight against Lord God of our fathers, because it will not prosper for you.

**2 Chronicles 13:13**

And Ieroboam turned ambush to come upon them from behind, and battle was before Iouda and ambush behind them.

**2 Chronicles 13:14**

And Iouda turned and behold, battle was before and behind them, and they cried out to Lord, and priests sounded trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 13:15**

And men of Iouda shouted, and it came to pass when men of Iouda shouted, Lord struck Ieroboam and Israel before Abia and Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 13:16**

And sons of Israel fled from before Iouda, and Lord gave them into their hands.

**2 Chronicles 13:17**

And Abia and his people struck among them great blow, and five hundred thousand mighty men fell wounded from Israel.

**2 Chronicles 13:18**

And sons of Israel were humbled in that day, and sons of Iouda prevailed, because they hoped in Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 13:19**

And Abia pursued after Ieroboam and seized from him cities: Baithēl and its villages, and Isana and its villages, and Ephrōn and its villages.

**2 Chronicles 13:20**

And Ieroboam had no more strength all days of Abia, and Lord struck him and he died.

**2 Chronicles 13:21**

And Abia grew strong and took for himself fourteen wives and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

**2 Chronicles 13:22**

And rest of matters of Abia and his deeds and his words are written in book of prophet Addō.

**2 Chronicles 13:23**

And Abia died with his fathers, and they buried him in City of Dauid, and Asa his son reigned in his place. In days of Asa, land of Iouda was quiet ten years.

### Chapter 14

**2 Chronicles 14:1**

And he did good and upright in sight of Lord his God.

**2 Chronicles 14:2**

And he removed altars of foreigners and high places and broke pillars and cut down groves.

**2 Chronicles 14:3**

And he told Iouda to seek Lord God of their fathers and to do law and commandments.

**2 Chronicles 14:4**

And he removed from all cities of Iouda altars and idols, and land was at peace.

**2 Chronicles 14:5**

He built fortified cities in land of Iouda, because land was at peace, and there was no war with him in these years, because Lord gave him rest.

**2 Chronicles 14:6**

And he said to Iouda, Let us build these cities and make walls and towers and gates and bars, while we master land, because as we sought Lord our God, he sought us and gave us rest all around, and he prospered us.

**2 Chronicles 14:7**

And Asa had force of shield-bearers and spear-carriers in land of Iouda, three hundred thousand, and in land of Beniamin, peltasts and archers, two hundred fifty thousand. All these were mighty men of force.

**2 Chronicles 14:8**

And Zara the Aithiopian came out against them with force of one million and three hundred chariots and came as far as Marisa.

**2 Chronicles 14:9**

And Asa went out to meet him and drew up battle in ravine north of Marisa.

**2 Chronicles 14:10**

And Asa cried to Lord his God and said, Lord, with you it is not impossible to save with many and with few. Strengthen us, Lord our God, because in you we trust, and in your name we came against this great multitude. Lord our God, let not man prevail against you.

**2 Chronicles 14:11**

And Lord struck Aithiopians before Iouda, and Aithiopians fled.

**2 Chronicles 14:12**

And Asa and his people pursued them as far as Gedōr, and Aithiopians fell so that there was no preservation in them, because they were crushed before Lord and before his force, and they plundered many spoils.

**2 Chronicles 14:13**

And they cut off their villages around Gedōr, because terror of Lord came upon them, and they plundered all their cities, because there became much spoil for them.

**2 Chronicles 14:14**

And indeed they cut off tents of livestock of Amazons and took many sheep and camels and returned to Ierousalem.

### Chapter 15

**2 Chronicles 15:1**

And Azarias son of Ōdēd, spirit of Lord came upon him.

**2 Chronicles 15:2**

And he went out to meet Asa and all Iouda and Beniamin and said, Hear me, Asa and all Iouda and Beniamin: Lord is with you while you are with him, and if you seek him, he will be found by you, and if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

**2 Chronicles 15:3**

And many days Israel was without true God and without priest showing way and without law.

**2 Chronicles 15:4**

And he will return upon Lord God of Israel, and he will be found by them.

**2 Chronicles 15:5**

And in that time there is no peace to one going out and to one coming in, because terror of Lord is upon all dwelling in lands.

**2 Chronicles 15:6**

And nation will fight against nation and city against city, because God troubled them with every affliction.

**2 Chronicles 15:7**

And you, be strong, and do not let your hands be weakened, because there is reward for your work.

**2 Chronicles 15:8**

And when he heard these words and prophecy of Adad the prophet, he was strengthened and cast out abominations from all land of Iouda and Beniamin and from cities which he seized in mountain of Ephraim and renewed altar of Lord which was before temple of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 15:9**

And he assembled Iouda and Beniamin and sojourners dwelling with him from Ephraim and from Manasse and from Symeon, because many from Israel joined themselves to him when they saw that Lord his God was with him.

**2 Chronicles 15:10**

And they were gathered into Ierousalem in third month, in fifteenth year of kingdom of Asa.

**2 Chronicles 15:11**

And they sacrificed to Lord in that day from spoils they brought, seven hundred calves and seven thousand sheep.

**2 Chronicles 15:12**

And he entered into covenant to seek Lord God of their fathers with all heart and with all soul.

**2 Chronicles 15:13**

And everyone who would not seek Lord God of Israel shall die, from younger to elder, from man to woman.

**2 Chronicles 15:14**

And they swore in Lord with loud voice and with trumpets and with horns.

**2 Chronicles 15:15**

And all Iouda rejoiced over oath, because with all soul they swore and with all desire sought him, and he was found by them, and Lord gave them rest all around.

**2 Chronicles 15:16**

And he removed Maacha his mother from not being one serving Astarte, and he cut down idol and burned it in torrent of Kedrōn.

**2 Chronicles 15:17**

But high places were not removed; there was still in Israel. Yet heart of Asa became full all his days.

**2 Chronicles 15:18**

And he brought in holy things of Dauid his father and holy things of house of Lord God, silver and gold and vessels.

**2 Chronicles 15:19**

And there was no war with him until thirty-fifth year of kingdom of Asa.

### Chapter 16

**2 Chronicles 16:1**

And in thirty-eighth year of kingdom of Asa, Baasa king of Israel came up against Iouda and built Rama so as not to give exit and entry to Asa king of Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 16:2**

And Asa took gold and silver from treasures of house of Lord and house of king and sent to son of Ader king of Syria dwelling in Damascus, saying,

**2 Chronicles 16:3**

Make covenant between me and you and between my father and your father. Behold, I sent you gold and silver. Come, scatter away from me Baasa king of Israel, and let him depart from me.

**2 Chronicles 16:4**

And son of Ader listened to king Asa and sent chiefs of his force against cities of Israel, and he struck Iōn and Dan and Abelmain and all surrounding places of Nephthali.

**2 Chronicles 16:5**

And it came to pass when Baasa heard, he left off building Rama and stopped his work.

**2 Chronicles 16:6**

And Asa the king took all Iouda and took stones of Rama and its timbers, with which Baasa had built, and built with them Gabae and Maspha.

**2 Chronicles 16:7**

And at that time Anani the prophet came to Asa king of Iouda and said to him, Because you trusted in king of Syria and did not trust in Lord your God, because of this force of Syria escaped from your hand.

**2 Chronicles 16:8**

Were not Aithiopians and Libyans for very great force, for courage, horsemen in great multitude? Yet when you trusted in Lord, he gave them into your hands.

**2 Chronicles 16:9**

Because eyes of Lord look through all earth to strengthen every heart full toward him. You acted foolishly in this; from now on wars shall be with you.

**2 Chronicles 16:10**

And Asa was angry with prophet and put him in prison, because he was enraged over this, and Asa brought harm among people at that time.

**2 Chronicles 16:11**

And behold, matters of Asa, first and last, are written in book of kings of Iouda and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 16:12**

And Asa became diseased in his feet in thirty-ninth year of his kingdom, until he was very diseased, and in his disease he did not seek Lord but physicians.

**2 Chronicles 16:13**

And Asa slept with his fathers and died in thirty-ninth year of his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 16:14**

And they buried him in tomb which he dug for himself in City of Dauid and laid him on bier, and they filled it with spices and kinds of perfumed ointments, and they made for him very great funeral.

### Chapter 17

**2 Chronicles 17:1**

And Iōsaphat his son reigned in his place, and Iōsaphat prevailed over Israel.

**2 Chronicles 17:2**

And he put force in all fortified cities of Iouda and set rulers in all cities of Iouda and in cities of Ephraim which Asa his father seized.

**2 Chronicles 17:3**

And Lord was with Iōsaphat, because he walked in first ways of his father and did not seek idols,

**2 Chronicles 17:4**

but sought Lord God of his father and walked in commandments of his father and not according to works of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 17:5**

And Lord directed kingdom in his hand, and all Iouda gave gifts to Iōsaphat, and he had much wealth and glory.

**2 Chronicles 17:6**

And his heart was lifted high in way of Lord, and he further removed high places and groves from land of Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 17:7**

And in third year of his kingdom he sent his rulers and sons of mighty men, Abdian and Zacharian and Nathanaēl and Michaian, to teach in cities of Iouda,

**2 Chronicles 17:8**

and with them Levites Samouias and Nathanias and Zabdias and Asiēl and Semiramōth and Ionathan and Adōnias and Tōbias, the Levites, and with them Elisama and Iōram, the priests.

**2 Chronicles 17:9**

And they were teaching in Iouda, and with them was book of law of Lord, and they went through cities of Iouda and taught people.

**2 Chronicles 17:10**

And terror of Lord came upon all kingdoms of earth around Iouda, and they did not war against Iōsaphat.

**2 Chronicles 17:11**

And from Philistines they were bringing to Iōsaphat gifts and silver and tribute, and Arabs brought him seven thousand seven hundred rams of sheep.

**2 Chronicles 17:12**

And Iōsaphat was becoming greater and greater on high, and he built dwellings in Iouda and fortified cities.

**2 Chronicles 17:13**

And many works came to him in Iouda, and mighty men of war were strong in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 17:14**

And this was their number according to houses of their fathers: for Iouda, commanders of thousands: Ednas the chief, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of force;

**2 Chronicles 17:15**

and with him Iōanan the leader, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

**2 Chronicles 17:16**

and with him Amasias son of Zachri, one willingly given to Lord, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of force;

**2 Chronicles 17:17**

and from Beniamin, mighty man of force Eliada, and with him archers and peltasts, two hundred thousand;

**2 Chronicles 17:18**

and with him Iōzabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand mighty for war.

**2 Chronicles 17:19**

These were those ministering to king, besides those whom king placed in fortified cities in all Iouda.

### Chapter 18

**2 Chronicles 18:1**

And Iōsaphat had still much wealth and glory, and he joined by marriage with house of Achaab.

**2 Chronicles 18:2**

And after end of years he went down to Achaab in Samareia, and Achaab sacrificed to him many sheep and calves and to people with him, and deceived him to go up with him to Ramōth of Galaaditis.

**2 Chronicles 18:3**

And Achaab king of Israel said to Iōsaphat king of Iouda, Will you go with me to Ramōth of Galaaditis? And he said to him, As I am, so are you; as your people, so my people, with you in battle.

**2 Chronicles 18:4**

And Iōsaphat said to king of Israel, Seek now today Lord.

**2 Chronicles 18:5**

And king of Israel gathered prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go to Ramōth Galaad for battle, or shall I hold back? And they said, Go up, and God will give into hands of king.

**2 Chronicles 18:6**

And Iōsaphat said, Is there not here still prophet of Lord, and shall we seek through him?

**2 Chronicles 18:7**

And king of Israel said to Iōsaphat, There is still one man through whom to seek Lord, and I hated him, because he is not prophesying good concerning me, but all his days evil. This is Michaias son of Iemla. And Iōsaphat said, Let not king speak thus.

**2 Chronicles 18:8**

And king of Israel called one eunuch and said, Quickly, Michaias son of Iemla.

**2 Chronicles 18:9**

And king of Israel and Iōsaphat king of Iouda were sitting each on his throne, clothed in robes, sitting in broad place of gate of Samareia, and all prophets were prophesying before them.

**2 Chronicles 18:10**

And Sedekias son of Chanaana made for himself iron horns and said, Thus says Lord: With these you shall gore Syria until it is finished.

**2 Chronicles 18:11**

And all prophets were prophesying thus, saying, Go up to Ramōth Galaad and prosper, and Lord will give into hands of king.

**2 Chronicles 18:12**

And messenger who went to call Michaias spoke to him, saying, Behold, prophets spoke with one mouth good things about king. Let your words now be like one of them, and you shall speak good things.

**2 Chronicles 18:13**

And Michaias said, Lord lives, whatever God says to me, this I will speak.

**2 Chronicles 18:14**

And he came to king, and king said to him, Michaias, shall I go to Ramōth Galaad for battle, or shall I hold back? And he said, Go up, and you will prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.

**2 Chronicles 18:15**

And king said to him, How many times shall I make you swear that you speak to me nothing except truth in name of Lord?

**2 Chronicles 18:16**

And he said, I saw Israel scattered on mountains like sheep which have no shepherd, and Lord said, These have no ruler; let each return to his house in peace.

**2 Chronicles 18:17**

And king of Israel said to Iōsaphat, Did I not say to you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?

**2 Chronicles 18:18**

And he said, Not so. Hear word of Lord: I saw Lord sitting on his throne, and all force of heaven stood at his right and at his left.

**2 Chronicles 18:19**

And Lord said, Who will deceive Achaab king of Israel, and he will go up and fall in Ramōth Galaad? And one said thus and another said thus.

**2 Chronicles 18:20**

And spirit came out and stood before Lord and said, I will deceive him. And Lord said, In what way?

**2 Chronicles 18:21**

And he said, I will go out and be lying spirit in mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall deceive and you shall be able; go out and do so.

**2 Chronicles 18:22**

And now, behold, Lord has put lying spirit in mouth of all these prophets of yours, and Lord spoke evil against you.

**2 Chronicles 18:23**

And Sedekias son of Chanaana came near and struck Michaias on jaw and said to him, By what way did spirit of Lord pass from me to speak to you?

**2 Chronicles 18:24**

And Michaias said, Behold, you will see in that day when you enter chamber from chamber to hide yourself.

**2 Chronicles 18:25**

And king of Israel said, Take Michaias and return him to Emēr ruler of city and to Iōas ruler, son of king,

**2 Chronicles 18:26**

and say, Thus says king: Put this one into house of prison, and let him eat bread of affliction and water of affliction until I return in peace.

**2 Chronicles 18:27**

And Michaias said, If you indeed return in peace, Lord did not speak in me. Hear, all peoples.

**2 Chronicles 18:28**

And king of Israel and Iōsaphat king of Iouda went up to Ramōth Galaad.

**2 Chronicles 18:29**

And king of Israel said to Iōsaphat, I will disguise myself and enter into battle, and you put on my clothing. And king of Israel disguised himself and entered into battle.

**2 Chronicles 18:30**

And king of Syria commanded chiefs of chariots with him, saying, Do not fight small and great, except king of Israel only.

**2 Chronicles 18:31**

And it came to pass when chiefs of chariots saw Iōsaphat, they said, It is king of Israel. And they surrounded him to fight, and Iōsaphat cried out, and Lord saved him, and God turned them away from him.

**2 Chronicles 18:32**

And it came to pass when chiefs of chariots saw that he was not king of Israel, they turned away from him.

**2 Chronicles 18:33**

And a man bent bow by good aim and struck king of Israel between lung and between chest, and he said to driver, Turn your hand and bring me out of battle, because I am in pain.

**2 Chronicles 18:34**

And battle turned in that day, and king of Israel was standing on chariot until evening against Syria, and he died at setting of sun.

### Chapter 19

**2 Chronicles 19:1**

And Iōsaphat king of Iouda returned to his house in peace, to Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 19:2**

And Iou son of Anani the prophet went out to meet him and said to him, King Iōsaphat, do you help sinner, or make friendship with one hated by Lord? Because of this wrath came upon you from Lord.

**2 Chronicles 19:3**

Yet good matters were found in you, because you removed groves from land of Iouda and directed your heart to seek Lord.

**2 Chronicles 19:4**

And Iōsaphat dwelt in Ierousalem and again went out to people from Bersabee to mountain of Ephraim and turned them back to Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 19:5**

And he appointed judges in all fortified cities of Iouda, city by city.

**2 Chronicles 19:6**

And he said to judges, See what you do, because you do not judge for man, but for Lord, and matters of judgment are with you.

**2 Chronicles 19:7**

And now let fear of Lord be upon you, and keep and do, because with Lord our God there is no injustice, nor regard of face, nor taking of gifts.

**2 Chronicles 19:8**

And also in Ierousalem Iōsaphat appointed from priests and Levites and patriarchs of Israel for judgment of Lord and to judge those dwelling in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 19:9**

And he commanded them, saying, Thus you shall do in fear of Lord, in truth and with full heart.

**2 Chronicles 19:10**

Every case that comes upon you from your brothers dwelling in their cities, between blood and blood and between ordinance and commandment and statutes and judgments, you shall make distinction for them, and they shall not sin against Lord, and wrath shall not be on you and on your brothers. Thus you shall do and you shall not sin.

**2 Chronicles 19:11**

And behold, Amarias the priest is leader over you for every matter of Lord, and Zabdias son of Ismaēl is leader for house of Iouda for every matter of king, and scribes and Levites are before you. Be strong and do, and Lord shall be with good man.

### Chapter 20

**2 Chronicles 20:1**

And after these things sons of Moab and sons of Ammon and with them from Minaeans came against Iōsaphat for battle.

**2 Chronicles 20:2**

And they came and reported to Iōsaphat, saying, Great multitude has come against you from beyond sea, from Syria, and behold, they are in Asasanthamar, this is Engaddi.

**2 Chronicles 20:3**

And he feared, and Iōsaphat set his face to seek Lord and proclaimed fast in all Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 20:4**

And Iouda gathered to seek Lord, and from all cities of Iouda they came to seek Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:5**

And Iōsaphat stood in assembly of Iouda in Ierousalem, in house of Lord, before new court,

**2 Chronicles 20:6**

and said, Lord God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven, and do you not rule over all kingdoms of nations? And in your hand are strength and power, and none can stand against you.

**2 Chronicles 20:7**

Are you not Lord who destroyed inhabitants of this land from before your people Israel and gave it to seed of Abraam your beloved forever?

**2 Chronicles 20:8**

And they dwelt in it and built in it sanctuary to your name, saying,

**2 Chronicles 20:9**

If evils come upon us, sword, judgment, death, famine, we shall stand before this house and before you, because your name is upon this house, and we shall cry to you from affliction, and you will hear and save.

**2 Chronicles 20:10**

And now, behold, sons of Ammon and Moab and mount Sēir, through whom you did not allow Israel to pass when they came out from land of Egypt, because they turned away from them and did not destroy them,

**2 Chronicles 20:11**

and now, behold, they attempt against us, to come cast us out from our inheritance which you gave us.

**2 Chronicles 20:12**

Lord our God, will you not judge among them? Because there is no strength in us to stand against this great multitude that came upon us, and we do not know what we should do, but our eyes are upon you.

**2 Chronicles 20:13**

And all Iouda stood before Lord, and their little children and wives.

**2 Chronicles 20:14**

And upon Oziēl son of Zachariou, from sons of Banaiou, from sons of Elēēl, from Mathaniou the Levite, from sons of Asaph, spirit of Lord came in assembly,

**2 Chronicles 20:15**

and he said, Hear, all Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem and king Iōsaphat. Thus says Lord to you: Do not fear and do not be dismayed before this great multitude, because battle is not yours but God’s.

**2 Chronicles 20:16**

Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are going up by ascent of Asas, and you will find them at end of river of wilderness Ieriiēl.

**2 Chronicles 20:17**

It is not for you to fight in this. Stand and see salvation of Lord with you, Iouda and Ierousalem. Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Tomorrow go out to meet them, and Lord is with you.

**2 Chronicles 20:18**

And Iōsaphat bowed with face to ground, and all Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem fell before Lord to worship Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:19**

And Levites from sons of Kaath and from sons of Korē rose to praise Lord God of Israel with very great loud voice.

**2 Chronicles 20:20**

And they rose early in morning and went out into wilderness of Thekōe, and as they went out, Iōsaphat stood and cried, saying, Hear me, Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem. Trust in Lord your God and you shall be trusted; trust in his prophet and you shall prosper.

**2 Chronicles 20:21**

And he took counsel with people and set singers and praisers to give thanks and praise holy things as they went out before force, and they said, Give thanks to Lord, because his mercy is forever.

**2 Chronicles 20:22**

And when he began praise of thanksgiving, Lord made sons of Ammon fight against Moab and mount Sēir, those coming out against Iouda, and they were routed.

**2 Chronicles 20:23**

And sons of Ammon and Moab rose against inhabitants of mount Sēir to destroy and wipe out, and when they finished inhabitants of Sēir, they rose against one another for destruction.

**2 Chronicles 20:24**

And Iouda came to watchtower of wilderness and looked, and saw multitude, and behold, all were dead, fallen on ground; there was none being saved.

**2 Chronicles 20:25**

And Iōsaphat and his people came to plunder their spoils and found many cattle and baggage and spoils and desirable vessels, and they plundered for themselves, and it was three days they plundered spoils, because it was much.

**2 Chronicles 20:26**

And on fourth day they were gathered to valley of blessing, because there they blessed Lord. Therefore name of that place was called Valley of Blessing until this day.

**2 Chronicles 20:27**

And every man of Iouda returned to Ierousalem, and Iōsaphat leading them, with great gladness, because Lord gladdened them from their enemies.

**2 Chronicles 20:28**

And they entered into Ierousalem with harps and lyres and trumpets to house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:29**

And terror of Lord came upon all kingdoms of earth when they heard that Lord fought against adversaries of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 20:30**

And kingdom of Iōsaphat was at peace, and his God gave him rest all around.

**2 Chronicles 20:31**

And Iōsaphat reigned over Iouda, being thirty-five years old when he reigned, and he reigned twenty-five years in Ierousalem, and his mother’s name was Azouba daughter of Sali.

**2 Chronicles 20:32**

And he walked in ways of Asa his father and did not turn aside from doing upright in sight of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:33**

But high places still existed, and people still did not direct heart toward Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 20:34**

And rest of matters of Iōsaphat, first and last, behold, written in words of Iou son of Anani, who wrote book of kings of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 20:35**

And after these things Iōsaphat king of Iouda joined himself with Ochozias king of Israel, and he acted lawlessly.

**2 Chronicles 20:36**

In making and going with him to make ships to go to Tharsis, he made ships in Gasiōngaber.

**2 Chronicles 20:37**

And Eliezer son of Dōdia from Marisa prophesied against Iōsaphat, saying, Because you made friendship with Ochozias, Lord broke your work, and your ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tharsis.

### Chapter 21

**2 Chronicles 21:1**

And Iōsaphat slept with his fathers and was buried beside his fathers in City of Dauid, and Iōram his son reigned in his place.

**2 Chronicles 21:2**

And he had brothers, sons of Iōsaphat: Azarias and Iiēl and Zacharias and Azarias and Michaēl and Saphatias; all these were sons of Iōsaphat king of Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 21:3**

And their father gave them many gifts, silver and gold and weapons, with fortified cities in Iouda, but kingdom he gave to Iōram, because he was firstborn.

**2 Chronicles 21:4**

And Iōram rose over his kingdom and grew strong and killed all his brothers with sword, and also from rulers of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 21:5**

Iōram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and eight years he reigned in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 21:6**

And he walked in way of kings of Israel, as house of Achaab did, because daughter of Achaab was his wife, and he did evil before Lord.

**2 Chronicles 21:7**

And Lord did not want to destroy house of Dauid because of covenant which he made with Dauid and as he said to give to him lamp and to his sons all days.

**2 Chronicles 21:8**

In those days Edōm rebelled from Iouda and made king over themselves.

**2 Chronicles 21:9**

And Iōram went with rulers and all cavalry with him, and it came to pass, he rose by night and struck Edōm encircling him and commanders of chariots, and people fled to their tents.

**2 Chronicles 21:10**

And Edōm rebelled from Iouda until this day. Then Lobna rebelled at that time from his hand, because he forsook Lord God of his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 21:11**

And he too made high places in cities of Iouda and prostituted inhabitants of Ierousalem and led Iouda astray.

**2 Chronicles 21:12**

And writing came to him from Ēlias the prophet, saying, Thus says Lord God of Dauid your father: Because you did not walk in way of Iōsaphat your father and in ways of Asa king of Iouda,

**2 Chronicles 21:13**

but walked in ways of kings of Israel and prostituted Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem as house of Achaab prostituted, and you killed your brothers, sons of your father, those better than you,

**2 Chronicles 21:14**

behold, Lord will strike you with great plague among your people and among your sons and among your wives and among all your baggage.

**2 Chronicles 21:15**

And you with evil weakness, in disease of belly, until your belly comes out with sickness from day to day.

**2 Chronicles 21:16**

And Lord stirred up against Iōram Philistines and Arabs and neighbors of Aithiopians.

**2 Chronicles 21:17**

And they went up against Iouda and overpowered and carried away all baggage they found in house of king and his sons and his daughters, and no son was left to him except Ochozias, youngest of his sons.

**2 Chronicles 21:18**

And after all these things Lord struck him in belly with weakness that had no healing.

**2 Chronicles 21:19**

And it came to pass from days to days, and as time of days came, two days, his belly came out with disease, and he died in evil weakness, and his people did not make funeral for him like funeral of his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 21:20**

He was thirty-two years old when he reigned, and eight years he reigned in Ierousalem, and he went away without praise and was buried in City of Dauid, but not in tombs of kings.

### Chapter 22

**2 Chronicles 22:1**

And inhabitants of Ierousalem made Ochozias his son, youngest, king in his place, because raiding band that came upon them, Arabs and Alimazones, killed all elders. And Ochozias son of Iōram king of Iouda reigned.

**2 Chronicles 22:2**

Ochozias was twenty years old when he reigned, and one year he reigned in Ierousalem, and his mother’s name was Gotholia daughter of Ambri.

**2 Chronicles 22:3**

And he walked in way of house of Achaab, because his mother was counselor to him in sinning.

**2 Chronicles 22:4**

And he did evil before Lord like house of Achaab, because they were counselors to him after death of his father, to destroy him.

**2 Chronicles 22:5**

And in their counsels he walked and went with Iōram son of Achaab to war against Azaēl king of Syria at Rama Galaad, and archers struck Iōram.

**2 Chronicles 22:6**

And Iōram returned to be healed in Iezrael from wounds which Syrians gave him in Rama when he fought Azaēl king of Syria, and Ochozias son of Iōram king of Iouda came down to visit Iōram son of Achaab in Iezrael, because he was sick.

**2 Chronicles 22:7**

And from God came destruction of Ochozias by coming to Iōram. And when he came, Iōram went out with him toward Iou son of Namessi, anointed of Lord, against house of Achaab.

**2 Chronicles 22:8**

And it came to pass when Iou avenged house of Achaab and found rulers of Iouda and brothers of Ochozias ministering to Ochozias, he killed them.

**2 Chronicles 22:9**

And he told them to seek Ochozias, and they seized him while he was being healed in Samareia and brought him to Iou, and he killed him and buried him, because they said, He is son of Iōsaphat who sought Lord with whole heart. And there was none in house of Ochozias strong enough for kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 22:10**

And Gotholia mother of Ochozias saw that her son was dead, and she rose and destroyed all royal seed in house of Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 22:11**

And Iōsabeath daughter of king took Iōas son of Ochozias and stole him from midst of king’s sons who were being put to death and put him and his nurse in chamber of beds. And Iōsabeath daughter of king Iōram, sister of Ochozias, wife of Iōdae the priest, hid him from before Gotholia, and she did not kill him.

**2 Chronicles 22:12**

And he was with her in house of God, hidden six years, and Gotholia reigned over land.

### Chapter 23

**2 Chronicles 23:1**

And in seventh year Iōdae strengthened himself and took the centurions, Azarian son of Iōram and Ismaēl son of Iōanan and Azarian son of Ōbēd and Maasaias son of Adaia and Elisaphan son of Zacharia, with him into house.

**2 Chronicles 23:2**

And they went around Iouda and gathered Levites from all cities of Iouda and chiefs of fathers of Israel and came to Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 23:3**

And all assembly of Iouda made covenant in house of God with king, and he showed them son of king and said to them, Behold, son of king, let him reign, as Lord spoke concerning house of Dauid.

**2 Chronicles 23:4**

Now this is thing which you shall do: one-third of you entering on Sabbath, of priests and Levites, shall be at gates of entries,

**2 Chronicles 23:5**

and one-third in house of king, and one-third at middle gate, and all people in courts of house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:6**

And no one shall enter house of Lord except priests and Levites and ministers of Levites. They shall enter because they are holy, and all people shall keep charges of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:7**

And Levites shall surround king all around, each man with weapon in his hand, and one entering house shall die, and they shall be with king when he enters and goes out.

**2 Chronicles 23:8**

And Levites and all Iouda did according to all things which Iōdae the priest commanded, and each took his men from beginning of Sabbath to end of Sabbath, because Iōdae did not dismiss courses.

**2 Chronicles 23:9**

And he gave swords and shields and weapons which belonged to king Dauid in house of God.

**2 Chronicles 23:10**

And he set all people, each with his weapons, from shoulder of house on right to shoulder on left, by altar and by house, around king.

**2 Chronicles 23:11**

And they brought out son of king and put kingdom and testimonies upon him, and they made him king and anointed him, Iōdae and his sons, and said, Let king live.

**2 Chronicles 23:12**

And Gotholia heard sound of people running and giving thanks and praising king and entered to king in house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:13**

And she saw, and behold, king stood at his station and at entrance, rulers and trumpets around king, and all people of land rejoiced, and they sounded with trumpets, and singers with instruments of songs and hymning praise. And Gotholia tore her robe and cried, Conspiracy, conspire!

**2 Chronicles 23:14**

And Iōdae the priest went out and commanded centurions and leaders of force and said to them, Throw her out beyond house, and whoever enters after her, let him die by sword, because priest said, Let her not die in house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:15**

And they gave her free passage, and she went through horse gate of house of king, and they killed her there.

**2 Chronicles 23:16**

And Iōdae made covenant between himself and people and king, that they should be people to Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:17**

And all people of land entered house of Baal and pulled it down, and his altars and idols they crushed small, and Matthan priest of Baal they killed before his altars.

**2 Chronicles 23:18**

And Iōdae the priest entrusted works of house of Lord by hand of priests and Levites and restored courses of priests and Levites which Dauid appointed over house of Lord, to offer whole burnt offerings to Lord as written in law of Moyses, with gladness and with songs by hand of Dauid.

**2 Chronicles 23:19**

And they stationed gatekeepers at gates of house of Lord, and no unclean person in any matter shall enter.

**2 Chronicles 23:20**

And he took patriarchs and mighty men and rulers of people and all people of land, and brought up king to house of Lord, and entered by inner gate into house of king and seated king upon throne of kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 23:21**

And all people of land rejoiced, and city was quiet, and they killed Gotholia with sword.

### Chapter 24

**2 Chronicles 24:1**

Iōas was seven years old when he reigned, and forty years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Sabia from Bersabee.

**2 Chronicles 24:2**

And Iōas did upright in sight of Lord all days of Iōdae the priest.

**2 Chronicles 24:3**

And Iōdae took for him two wives, and he fathered sons and daughters.

**2 Chronicles 24:4**

And after these things it came upon heart of Iōas to repair house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 24:5**

And he gathered priests and Levites and said to them, Go out into cities of Iouda and gather from all Israel silver to strengthen house of Lord year by year, and hurry to speak. And Levites did not hurry.

**2 Chronicles 24:6**

And king Iōas called Iōdae the chief and said to him, Why did you not see about Levites to bring from Iouda and Ierousalem what was ordained by Moyses man of God when he assembled Israel for tent of testimony?

**2 Chronicles 24:7**

Because Gotholia was lawless, and her sons pulled down house of God, and indeed holy things of house of Lord they made for Baals.

**2 Chronicles 24:8**

And king said, Let a chest be made and placed at gate of house of Lord outside.

**2 Chronicles 24:9**

And let them proclaim in Iouda and in Ierousalem to bring to Lord as Moyses servant of God spoke upon Israel in wilderness.

**2 Chronicles 24:10**

And all rulers and all people gave and brought and put into chest until it was full.

**2 Chronicles 24:11**

And whenever chest was brought to king’s officers by hand of Levites, and when they saw silver had multiplied, then king’s scribe came and officer of high priest and emptied chest and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day and gathered much silver.

**2 Chronicles 24:12**

And king and Iōdae the priest gave it to those doing works for work of house of Lord, and they hired stonecutters and carpenters to repair house of Lord, and workers in iron and bronze to repair house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 24:13**

And workers did work, and length of works went up in their hands, and they restored house of Lord to its standing and strengthened it.

**2 Chronicles 24:14**

And when they finished, they brought remaining silver to king and to Iōdae, and they made vessels for house of Lord, ministering vessels for whole burnt offerings and censers of gold and silver, and they offered whole burnt offerings in house of Lord continually all days of Iōdae.

**2 Chronicles 24:15**

And Iōdae grew old, full of days, and died, being one hundred thirty years old at his death.

**2 Chronicles 24:16**

And they buried him in City of Dauid with kings, because he did goodness with Israel and with God and his house.

**2 Chronicles 24:17**

And after death of Iōdae, rulers of Iouda came and bowed to king; then king listened to them.

**2 Chronicles 24:18**

And they forsook Lord God of their fathers and served Astartes and idols, and wrath came upon Iouda and Ierousalem in this day.

**2 Chronicles 24:19**

And he sent prophets to them to return to Lord, and they did not listen, and they testified to them and they did not listen.

**2 Chronicles 24:20**

And spirit of God clothed Azarian son of Iōdae the priest, and he stood above people and said, Thus says Lord: Why do you transgress commandments of Lord and not prosper? Because you forsake Lord, he will forsake you.

**2 Chronicles 24:21**

And they conspired against him and stoned him by command of king Iōas in court of house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 24:22**

And Iōas did not remember mercy which Iōdae his father did with him and killed his son. And as he was dying, he said, Let Lord see and judge.

**2 Chronicles 24:23**

And it came to pass after completion of year, force of Syria came up against him and came upon Iouda and Ierousalem and destroyed all rulers of people among people, and all their spoils they sent to king of Damascus.

**2 Chronicles 24:24**

Because with few men force of Syria came, and God gave into their hands very great force, because they forsook Lord God of their fathers, and against Iōas he made judgments.

**2 Chronicles 24:25**

And after they departed from him, leaving him in great weaknesses, his servants conspired against him over bloods of son of Iōdae the priest and killed him on his bed, and he died. And they buried him in City of Dauid, but they did not bury him in tomb of kings.

**2 Chronicles 24:26**

And those conspiring against him were Zabed son of Samath the Ammonite and Iōzabed son of Sōmarōth the Moabite.

**2 Chronicles 24:27**

And all his sons and the five things brought upon him and the rest, behold, written on commentary of kings, and Amasias his son reigned in his place.

### Chapter 25

**2 Chronicles 25:1**

Amasias was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Iōaden from Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 25:2**

And he did upright in sight of Lord, but not with full heart.

**2 Chronicles 25:3**

And it came to pass when kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who killed king his father.

**2 Chronicles 25:4**

But their sons he did not kill, according to covenant of law of Lord, as written, as Lord commanded, saying, Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers, but each shall die for his own sin.

**2 Chronicles 25:5**

And Amasias gathered house of Iouda and set them by houses of their fathers over thousands and hundreds in all Iouda and Ierousalem, and counted them from twenty years old and upward and found them three hundred thousand able to go out to battle, holding spear and shield.

**2 Chronicles 25:6**

And he hired from Israel one hundred thousand mighty men of strength for one hundred talents of silver.

**2 Chronicles 25:7**

And man of God came to him, saying, King, force of Israel shall not go with you, because Lord is not with Israel, with all sons of Ephraim.

**2 Chronicles 25:8**

Because if you suppose to prevail by these, Lord will rout you before enemies, because with Lord there is power both to strengthen and to route.

**2 Chronicles 25:9**

And Amasias said to man of God, And what shall I do with hundred talents which I gave to force of Israel? And man of God said, Lord is able to give you many more than these.

**2 Chronicles 25:10**

And Amasias separated force that came to him from Ephraim to go to their place, and they were very angry against Iouda and returned to their place in heat of anger.

**2 Chronicles 25:11**

And Amasias strengthened himself and took his people and went to valley of salt pits and struck there ten thousand sons of Sēir.

**2 Chronicles 25:12**

And ten thousand sons of Iouda took captive alive and brought them to top of cliff and threw them down from top of cliff, and all were broken apart.

**2 Chronicles 25:13**

And sons of force whom Amasias sent back from not going with him to war attacked cities of Iouda from Samareia to Baithōrōn and struck among them three thousand and plundered much spoil.

**2 Chronicles 25:14**

And it came to pass after Amasias came from striking Idoumaia, he brought to them gods of sons of Sēir and set them up for himself as gods, and bowed before them and burned sacrifice to them.

**2 Chronicles 25:15**

And anger of Lord came upon Amasias and he sent prophets to him and said to him, Why did you seek gods of people who did not rescue their own people from your hand?

**2 Chronicles 25:16**

And it came to pass as he spoke to him, he said to him, Have I made you counselor of king? Take heed lest you be whipped. And prophet was silent and said, I know that this was intended against you to destroy you, because you did this and did not listen to my counsel.

**2 Chronicles 25:17**

And Amasias took counsel and sent to Iōas son of Iōachaz son of Iou king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in face.

**2 Chronicles 25:18**

And Iōas king of Israel sent to Amasias king of Iouda, saying, Thornbush in Lebanon sent to cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for wife. And behold, beasts of field in Lebanon came and trampled thornbush.

**2 Chronicles 25:19**

You said, Behold, you struck Idoumaia, and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now sit in your house. Why provoke evil and fall, you and Iouda with you?

**2 Chronicles 25:20**

And Amasias did not listen, because it came from Lord to hand him over, because he sought gods of Idoumaians.

**2 Chronicles 25:21**

And Iōas king of Israel went up, and they looked one another in face, he and Amasias king of Iouda, at Baithsamys, which belongs to Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 25:22**

And Iouda was routed before Israel, and each fled to his tent.

**2 Chronicles 25:23**

And Iōas king of Israel seized Amasias king of Iouda, son of Iōas, at Baithsamys and brought him to Ierousalem and pulled down from wall of Ierousalem, from gate of Ephraim to corner gate, four hundred cubits.

**2 Chronicles 25:24**

And all gold and silver and all vessels found in house of Lord and with Abdedom and treasures of house of king and sons of mixtures, and he returned to Samareia.

**2 Chronicles 25:25**

And Amasias son of Iōas king of Iouda lived after death of Iōas son of Iōachaz king of Israel fifteen years.

**2 Chronicles 25:26**

And rest of matters of Amasiou, first and last, behold, written upon book of kings of Iouda and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 25:27**

And at time when Amasias rebelled from Lord they conspired against him, and he fled from Ierousalem to Lachis, and they sent after him to Lachis and killed him there.

**2 Chronicles 25:28**

And they carried him upon horses and buried him with his fathers in City of Dauid.

### Chapter 26

**2 Chronicles 26:1**

And all people of land took Ozia, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Amasiou.

**2 Chronicles 26:2**

He built Ailath; he restored it to Iouda after king slept with his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 26:3**

Ozias was sixteen years old when he reigned, and fifty-two years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Chalia from Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 26:4**

And he did upright in sight of Lord according to all things Amasias his father did.

**2 Chronicles 26:5**

And he was seeking Lord in days of Zachariou, one understanding in fear of Lord, and in his days he sought Lord and Lord prospered him.

**2 Chronicles 26:6**

And he went out and fought against Philistines and pulled down walls of Geth and walls of Iabnē and walls of Azōtos and built cities of Azōtos and among Philistines.

**2 Chronicles 26:7**

And Lord strengthened him against Philistines and against Arabs dwelling upon rock and against Minaeans.

**2 Chronicles 26:8**

And Minaeans gave gifts to Ozia, and his name was until entrance of Egypt, because he grew strong exceedingly.

**2 Chronicles 26:9**

And Ozias built towers in Ierousalem, at corner gate and at valley gate and at corners, and strengthened them.

**2 Chronicles 26:10**

And he built towers in wilderness and cut many pits, because much cattle belonged to him in lowland and in plain, and vine-workers in hill-country and in Carmel, because he loved farming.

**2 Chronicles 26:11**

And Ozias had forces making war and going out for battle in number, and their number by hand of Iiēl the scribe and Maasaiou the judge, by hand of Ananiou, successor of king.

**2 Chronicles 26:12**

Whole number of patriarchs of mighty men for war was two thousand six hundred.

**2 Chronicles 26:13**

And with them military force was three hundred seven thousand five hundred, those doing war with strength of power to help king against adversaries.

**2 Chronicles 26:14**

And Ozias prepared for them, for all force, shields and spears and helmets and breastplates and bows and sling-stones.

**2 Chronicles 26:15**

And he made in Ierousalem machines, invented by designer, to be on towers and corners, to cast arrows and large stones, and sound of their making was heard far away, because he was marvelously helped until he became strong.

**2 Chronicles 26:16**

And when he became strong, his heart was lifted up to ruin, and he acted unjustly against Lord his God and entered into temple of Lord to burn incense on altar of incense.

**2 Chronicles 26:17**

And Azarias the priest entered after him and with him eighty priests of Lord, mighty sons.

**2 Chronicles 26:18**

And they stood against Ozia the king and said to him, Not for you, Ozia, to burn incense to Lord, but for priests, sons of Aaron, those sanctified to burn incense. Go out from sanctuary, because you rebelled from Lord, and this shall not be for glory to you from Lord God.

**2 Chronicles 26:19**

And Ozias was angry, and in his hand was censer to burn incense in temple, and when he was angry with priests, leprosy rose in his forehead before priests in house of Lord above altar of incense.

**2 Chronicles 26:20**

And chief priest and priests turned to him, and behold, he was leprous in forehead, and they hurried him out from there, and indeed he himself hurried to go out because Lord rebuked him.

**2 Chronicles 26:21**

And Ozias the king was leprous until day of his death, and as leper he sat in house Aphphousōth, because he was cut off from house of Lord, and Iōatham his son was over kingdom, judging people of land.

**2 Chronicles 26:22**

And rest of matters of Oziou, first and last, were written by Iēssiou the prophet.

**2 Chronicles 26:23**

And Ozias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in field of burial of kings, because they said he is leprous, and Iōatham his son reigned in his place.

### Chapter 27

**2 Chronicles 27:1**

Iōatham was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Ierousa daughter of Sadok.

**2 Chronicles 27:2**

And he did upright in sight of Lord according to all things which Oziou his father did, but he did not enter into temple of Lord, and still people were being corrupted.

**2 Chronicles 27:3**

He built high gate of house of Lord, and in wall of Ophal he built much.

**2 Chronicles 27:4**

And he built cities in mountain of Iouda, and in forests dwellings and towers.

**2 Chronicles 27:5**

He fought against king of sons of Ammon and prevailed over him, and sons of Ammon gave him year by year one hundred talents of silver and ten thousand kors of wheat and ten thousand of barley. These king of Ammon brought him in first year and second and third.

**2 Chronicles 27:6**

And Iōatham grew strong, because he prepared his ways before Lord his God.

**2 Chronicles 27:7**

And rest of matters of Iōatham and war and deeds of him, behold, written in book of kings of Iouda and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 27:9**

And Iōatham slept with his fathers and was buried in City of Dauid, and Achaz his son reigned in his place.

### Chapter 28

**2 Chronicles 28:1**

Achaz was twenty years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Ierousalem, and he did not do upright in sight of Lord like Dauid his father.

**2 Chronicles 28:2**

And he walked according to ways of kings of Israel, and indeed he made carved things for their idols.

**2 Chronicles 28:3**

And he sacrificed in Gaibennom and brought his children through fire according to abominations of nations which Lord destroyed from before sons of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:4**

And he burned incense on high places and on roofs and under every grove tree.

**2 Chronicles 28:5**

And Lord his God gave him into hand of king of Syria, and he struck him and took from them many captives and brought them to Damascus. And indeed into hands of king of Israel he gave him, and he struck him with great blow.

**2 Chronicles 28:6**

And Phakee son of Romelia king of Israel killed in Iouda in one day one hundred twenty thousand mighty men of strength, because they forsook Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 28:7**

And Ezechri, mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maasaias son of king and Esdrikam ruler of his house and Elkana successor of king.

**2 Chronicles 28:8**

And sons of Israel took captive from their brothers three hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and they plundered much spoil from them and brought spoil to Samareia.

**2 Chronicles 28:9**

And there was prophet of Lord there, Odēd his name, and he went out to meet force coming to Samareia and said to them, Behold, wrath of Lord God of your fathers came upon Iouda and he gave them into your hands, and you killed among them in wrath reaching to heavens.

**2 Chronicles 28:10**

And now sons of Iouda and Ierousalem you say to acquire as male and female servants. Behold, am I not with you to testify to Lord your God?

**2 Chronicles 28:11**

And now hear me and return captivity which you took captive from your brothers, because wrath of heat of Lord is upon you.

**2 Chronicles 28:12**

And rulers from sons of Ephraim rose up: Oudia son of Iōanou and Barachias son of Mosolamōth and Ezechias son of Sellēm and Amasias son of Chodli, against those coming from war.

**2 Chronicles 28:13**

And they said to them, You shall not bring captivity here to us, because you say to add upon our sins and upon our ignorance in sinning to Lord, because our sin is great, and heat of wrath of Lord is upon Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:14**

And warriors left captivity and spoils before rulers and all assembly.

**2 Chronicles 28:15**

And men called by name rose and took hold of captivity, and all naked they clothed from spoils and dressed them and shod them and gave them to eat and to be anointed, and took hold of every weak one on beasts of burden and set them in Iericho, city of palms, by their brothers, and returned to Samareia.

**2 Chronicles 28:16**

At that time Achaz sent to king of Assour to help him.

**2 Chronicles 28:17**

And also because Idoumaians attacked and struck in Iouda and took captivity.

**2 Chronicles 28:18**

And Philistines attacked cities of plain and of south of Iouda and took Baithsamys and Ailōn and Gadērōth and Sokchō and its villages and Thamna and its villages and Gamzō and its villages, and they dwelt there.

**2 Chronicles 28:19**

Because Lord humbled Iouda through Achaz king of Iouda, because he rebelled in rebellion from Lord.

**2 Chronicles 28:20**

And Thaglathfellasar king of Assour came upon him and struck him.

**2 Chronicles 28:21**

And Achaz took what was in house of Lord and in house of king and of rulers and gave to king of Assour, and it was not for help to him.

**2 Chronicles 28:22**

But when he was afflicted he added to rebel further from Lord, and king said,

**2 Chronicles 28:23**

I will seek gods of Damascus who strike me. And he said, Because gods of king of Syria strengthened them, therefore I will sacrifice to them and they will help me. But they became to him as stumbling-block and to all Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:24**

And Achaz removed vessels of house of Lord and cut them up and shut doors of house of Lord and made for himself altars in every corner in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 28:25**

And in every city of Iouda he made high places to burn incense to foreign gods, and they provoked Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 28:26**

And rest of his matters and his deeds, first and last, behold, written upon book of kings of Iouda and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:27**

And Achaz slept with his fathers and was buried in City of Dauid, because they did not bring him into tombs of kings of Israel, and Ezekias his son reigned in his place.

### Chapter 29

**2 Chronicles 29:1**

And Ezekias reigned, being twenty-five years old, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Abba daughter of Zacharia.

**2 Chronicles 29:2**

And he did upright in sight of Lord according to all things Dauid his father did.

**2 Chronicles 29:3**

And it came to pass when he stood over his kingdom, in first month, he opened doors of house of Lord and repaired them.

**2 Chronicles 29:4**

And he brought in priests and Levites and stationed them in east court.

**2 Chronicles 29:5**

And he said to them, Hear, Levites. Now sanctify yourselves and sanctify house of Lord God of your fathers and throw out uncleanness from holy place.

**2 Chronicles 29:6**

Because our fathers rebelled and did evil before Lord and forsook him and turned face away from tent of Lord and gave neck.

**2 Chronicles 29:7**

And they shut doors of temple and quenched lamps and did not burn incense and did not offer whole burnt offerings in holy place to God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 29:8**

And wrath of Lord was against Iouda and Ierousalem, and he gave them to terror and to desolation and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.

**2 Chronicles 29:9**

And behold, your fathers have fallen by sword and your sons and daughters and wives are in captivity in land not theirs, which even now is so.

**2 Chronicles 29:10**

Upon these things now it is in my heart to make covenant of Lord God of Israel, and he will turn away heat of his wrath from us.

**2 Chronicles 29:11**

And now do not fail, because Lord chose in you to stand before him to minister and to be ministers and burners of incense.

**2 Chronicles 29:12**

And Levites rose: Maath son of Amasi and Ioēl son of Azariou from sons of Kaath, and from sons of Merari, Kis son of Abdi and Azarias son of Iallēl, and from sons of Gedsōni, Iōa son of Zemmath and Iōdan son of Iōacha,

**2 Chronicles 29:13**

and from sons of Elisaphan, Sambri and Iiēl, and from sons of Asaph, Zacharias and Maththanias,

**2 Chronicles 29:14**

and from sons of Haiman, Iiēl and Semei, and from sons of Idithōn, Samaias and Oziēl.

**2 Chronicles 29:15**

And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves according to command of king by ordinance of Lord to cleanse house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:16**

And priests entered inside house of Lord to sanctify it and threw out every uncleanness found in house of Lord into court of house of Lord, and Levites received it to throw outside into torrent of Kedrōn.

**2 Chronicles 29:17**

And they began on first day of new moon of first month to sanctify, and on eighth day of month they entered temple of Lord, and they sanctified house of Lord in eight days, and on sixteenth day of first month they finished.

**2 Chronicles 29:18**

And they went inside to Ezekias the king and said, We sanctified all things in house of Lord, altar of whole burnt offering and its vessels and table of presentation and its vessels.

**2 Chronicles 29:19**

And all vessels which king Achaz defiled in his kingdom in his rebellion we prepared and sanctified. Behold, they are before altar of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:20**

And Ezekias the king rose early and gathered rulers of city and went up to house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:21**

And they brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven male goats of goats for sin, for kingdom and for holy things and for Israel, and he told sons of Aaron the priests to go up upon altar of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:22**

And they slaughtered calves, and priests received blood and poured it upon altar, and they slaughtered rams and poured blood upon altar, and they slaughtered lambs and poured blood to altar.

**2 Chronicles 29:23**

And they brought male goats for sin before king and assembly, and they put hands upon them.

**2 Chronicles 29:24**

And priests slaughtered them and made atonement with their blood toward altar and made atonement for all Israel, because king said whole burnt offering and sin offerings were for all Israel.

**2 Chronicles 29:25**

And he stationed Levites in house of Lord with cymbals and harps and lyres according to command of Dauid king and Gad the seer for king and Nathan the prophet, because ordinance was from Lord by hand of prophets.

**2 Chronicles 29:26**

And Levites stood with instruments of Dauid, and priests with trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 29:27**

And Ezekias said to offer whole burnt offering upon altar, and when they began to offer whole burnt offering, they began to sing to Lord, and trumpets with instruments of Dauid king of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 29:28**

**2 Chronicles 29:29**

### Chapter 32

**2 Chronicles 32:1**
